messages:
incident-bot: PAGING — Dedicated pool capacity alert for tenant Northfield Financial (pool nf-prod-01). GPUs saturated 100% for 12m, queue rising. Paging @sre-oncall. alert:id=INC-17680055, severity=high, impact=customer latency spike >3s. https://rwd.ing/alerts/INC-17680055
sara: ack, I'm oncall. pulling metrics now.
sara: quick summary — nf-prod-01: 12/12 GPUs busy, queued requests 350, avg token latency 3.8s, autoscale attempted but failed with error: quota_exceeded (project:nf-tenant). burst limit blocked.
mike: infra check: autoscaler did request extra nodes but cloud quota for project nf-tenant is 0 additional GPUs. Cloud ticket required. We can evict low-priority batch jobs to free ~2 GPUs immediately.
alan: alternative mitigation — route overflow to hosted fallback model rwd-gen-7b-small in us-east-1 (higher per-token cost, slightly higher latency) until capacity returns. Can be toggled quickly.
sara: proposed immediate plan: 1) evict batch/non-critical pods to free GPUs, 2) enable routing fallback for nf-tenant to hosted variant, 3) open manual burst/quota escalation with infra. Any objections? :thinking:
tess-sales: +1 to customer comms. I'll ping Northfield and prep a short note. They may have kicked a large overnight reconciliation job.
northfield-nick: (via customer channel) confirmed — we started a reconciliation run late last night. We can pause if that helps. What do you recommend?
mike: eviction command ready to run (will take ~3-5m to drain):
```
rwdctl pool evict --pool nf-prod-01 --label batch=true --target-gpus 2 --dry-run=false
```
This will evict low-priority pods and free GPUs.
alan: routing change payload (I can apply now):
```
POST /routing/policies
{ "tenant": "northfield", "fallback": "rwd-gen-7b-small", "ratio": 0.6, "duration": "30m" }
```
Sets 60% traffic to fallback for 30m.
sara: executing eviction now.
ops-bot: Eviction job started by sara. Pool=nf-prod-01, targeting label=batch=true.
ops-bot: Eviction complete — freed 2 GPUs. Pool usage now 10/12, queued requests dropped 350 -> 160 over 4m.
mike: opened cloud quota ticket #CLD-8932 to request +4 GPUs for nf-tenant (submitted with priority=high). ETA unknown — pinged cloud on-call.
alan: routing fallback applied. Current traffic split for northfield: 60% fallback (rwd-gen-7b-small), 40% dedicated. Observed latency drop to ~2.1s overall. Token cost up but customer impact reduced.
sara: customer notified, @northfield-nick confirmed they will pause the reconciliation for 30m to let system backfill.
northfield-nick: paused the job, will requeue in 35m. Appreciate the quick response.
lee: I'll be taking the next oncall handoff in 15m. Handoff summary: incident stabilized via eviction + fallback routing; manual burst pending cloud ticket CLD-8932; monitor for 1h and confirm cloud approval or re-enable extra routing if needed. Action items in runbook: follow cloud ticket, confirm no regression on fallback outputs, coordinate re-enable with Northfield.
sara: handing off to lee — logs, runbook, and dashboard snapshots attached: https://rwd.ing/dashboards/nf-prod-01. I'll remain reachable in case the ticket moves.
incident-bot: Incident update — status=stabilized, severity downgraded to moderate, next automated update in 30m.
